svg.title: Meeting lifecycle - MeetingState with PauseReason (Engine, one MeetingRuntime per meeting)

g.text: Meeting lifecycle - MeetingState with PauseReason (Engine, one MeetingRuntime per meeting)
in Workplace mode, else the interview summary,
{ meeting_id: None, state: Idle } so windows
drop the meeting. It is refused while the
meeting is Starting / Active / Paused / Stopping.
can_transition_to also permits Starting -> Idle and Stopping -> Completed;
the Engine never requests them. Same-state moves are no-ops.
emergency_stop outside a live meeting changes no MeetingState;
it still sets processing_stopped, stops capture and hides the overlay.
Crash recovery (store): rows left starting / active / paused /
stopping / summarizing become completed at next launch
